The firmware reads D2 every 10 ms (**polling**).
고장 1: 버튼은 D2와 GND 사이에: Fault 1: the button goes between D2 and GND
D2는 **내부 풀업** 입력입니다. 버튼의 다른 쪽이 **3V3**에: D2 is an input with the **internal pull-up**. If the other side of the button is connected to **3V3**, the pin stays at 3.3 V even when pressed, so nothing changes.
Move the wire on the button's 2a side to **GND**.
**풀업 저항**은 핀을 약하게(약 40 kΩ) 3.3 V로 끌어올립니다: A **pull-up resistor** weakly (about 40 kΩ) pulls the pin up to 3.3 V.
- 버튼을 떼면: 핀 = 1 (풀업 때문에): - Button released: pin = 1 (because of the pull-up)
- 버튼을 누르면: 핀이 GND에 직접 연결 = 0: - Button pressed: the pin is connected directly to GND = 0
그래서 풀업 버튼은 **0이 눌림**입니다(active low). 풀업이: So for a pull-up button, **0 means pressed** (active low). Without a pull-up, the released pin floats and wanders between 0 and 1.
버튼 안에서 1a–1b, 2a–2b는 늘 붙어 있고, 누르면 1과 2가: Inside the button, 1a–1b and 2a–2b are always connected; pressing it connects 1 to 2.
LED가 거꾸로 꽂혀 있습니다. 애노드(A)가 저항(D7) 쪽, 캐소드(: The LED is plugged in backwards. The anode (A) must face the resistor (D7) and the cathode (K) must face GND.
Delete the LED and place it again, or swap its two wires.

버튼의 같은 쪽 핀(1a와 1b)에 연결 — 늘 붙어 있는 핀이라 버튼이: Connecting to pins on the same side of the button (1a and 1b) — they are always connected, so the button does nothing.
`== GPIO_PIN_SET`으로 눌림을 판단 — 풀업 버튼은 눌렀을: Detecting a press with `== GPIO_PIN_SET` — a pull-up button reads `GPIO_PIN_RESET` when pressed.
